description: The prose and section commands: `\details` and `\par` are the detailed description itself, `\remark` is a note by another name, and `\invariant`, `\todo`, `\bug`, `\version` and `\date` each have a field of their own. None of them may land in `custom`, which the bundled templates render nothing from.
raw:
/**
 * @brief A summary.
 * @details The long story.
 * @par Rationale
 * Because it is.
 * @remark worth knowing
 * @invariant the buffer stays sorted
 * @todo handle the empty case
 * @bug loops on a null node
 * @author Ada
 * @version 2.1
 * @date 2026-08-01
 */
